## 🚀 Feature Request

### Is your feature request related to a problem? 
A clear description of what the problem is. Ex. I'm always frustrated when [...]

### 💡 Solution You Want
A clear description of what you want to happen.

**Example:**
- Add new Artist Engine like [Marshmello / Illenium / Subtronics]
- Add new genre [Hardstyle / Psytrance / etc]
- Add new FX [e.g. better auto-tune, vinyl stop, etc]

### 🎛️ How Would It Work?
Describe how this feature would work in the studio:

1. User clicks...
2. Engine does...
3. Result is...

### 🎧 Why Would This Be Billboard-Grade?
Why would this make the remixer better / more pro?

### 📸 Mockup / Inspiration
Add any screenshots, YouTube links, or examples from other songs.

**Link:** [e.g. https://youtube.com/... ]

### 🔁 Alternatives Considered
Have you thought of any other ways to do this?

### 📝 Additional Context
Add any other context, screenshots, or examples about the feature request here.

### ✅ Checklist
- [ ] I checked if this feature was already requested
- [ ] This feature fits the EDM / Billboard vibe
- [ ] I'm willing to test this if it gets built
